snippet.title: Inner Voice - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
The shadows whisper… and now they speak!

Step into the world of "Inner Voice" that's coming in 2026!

A haunting narrative-driven horror experience set in the early 1900s.
The voice of Magnus White will guide you through a chilling preview of all four chapters. Each scene unveils a piece of the mystery, a flicker of the past, and a presence that was never meant to be disturbed!

- From abandoned homes to sacred grounds, every frame is a descent into the unknown.
- No combat. No escape. Just you, the silence… and the shadows!
